name: Parts of the Swarm
summary: From Thousand Needles, Korran sends word to Orgrimmar about Moktar and his studies.

sections.title: Word for Orgrimmar
sections.body: Korran sends you to Belgrom Rockmaul in Orgrimmar with word from Thousand Needles. The cracked carapaces came from silithid at the Rustmaul Digsite. Tell Belgrom that Moktar is doing his bidding well and that Korran's studies are progressing. Korran hopes to learn more soon.

sections.title: Belgrom's Reply
sections.body: Belgrom Rockmaul thanks you and says the warchief will be glad to hear of your tenacity. He promises to mention your name. Thrall speaks with Belgrom often and values his opinions. Belgrom considers the silithid a serious threat and wants to hear if Korran learns more about them.

aliases: who gave parts of the swarm
faq.answer: Korran, who studies the silithid, asks you to carry word to Belgrom Rockmaul in Orgrimmar.

faq.q: Who are you supposed to deliver the message to?
What message does Korran want delivered?
faq.answer: Tell Belgrom that Moktar is doing his bidding well in Thousand Needles and that Korran's studies are progressing. Korran hopes to learn more soon.

faq.q: What are the creatures Korran is studying?
faq.answer: They are silithid. The cracked carapaces that began this work came from silithid at the Rustmaul Digsite in Thousand Needles.
